`lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` (2785 lines) — already a `part of` library with many parts (agent_cli_commands.dart 896, agent_cli_waiting.dart 1010, agent_cli_compaction.dart 762, agent_cli_tools.dart 655, agent_cli_ext.dart 591, agent_cli_config.dart 837, plus smaller ones). The main file is still the edit magnet.

# Change
1. Read agent_cli.dart fully and map its remaining regions (slash-command dispatch tables, REPL loop, memory-section refresh, mailbox sync, shell-job settle bookkeeping, wake policy, HEP wiring, etc.).
2. Extract cohesive regions into NEW part files named `agent_cli_<concern>.dart` (extend the existing naming convention). Move the whole region: methods, fields, helpers it uses privately. If an existing part (e.g. agent_cli_commands.dart) has a clearly-matching concern AND stays under 2000 lines after absorbing it, extending an existing part is fine too — prefer NEW files for big distinct concerns to keep future churn distributed.
3. Keep in the primary file: the class declaration/core lifecycle plus whatever doesn't split cleanly. Target: primary file < 2000 lines (extract at least ~800 lines; extract more if cleanly possible). No part file may exceed 2000 lines either.
4. The ticket also asks for slash-command tables to self-register from part files where feasible — IF you find a low-risk mechanical way (e.g. a static list per part merged by the dispatcher) do it; if it would change behavior or ordering semantics, SKIP it and note that in your report. Ordering of slash-command matching must stay identical.

# Acceptance
- `wc -l lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` < 2000; no lib/src/cli/agent_cli*.dart over 2000.
- `dart format` clean on touched files; `dart analyze lib/src/cli` reports no issues.
- `dart test test/cli` passes (this is your area's suite — run it; if some tests are flaky for environment reasons, rerun once and report honestly).
- Report which command-table self-registration you did or skipped and why.

**Primary file: 2785 → 1954 lines** (−831). Nothing added to the primary except 4 `part` directives; public API (constructor, `run`, `runHeadless`, getters, test seams) and all instance *fields* stay in the class (extensions can't declare fields, so the run/picker field blocks with their docs remained — only methods/getters moved).

**New part files** (all `part of 'agent_cli.dart'`, named extensions on AgentCli, library-private members unchanged):
- `agent_cli_lifecycle.dart` (163) — run-lifecycle helpers: `_registerLivePresence`, `_startInboxWatcher`, `_teardownAfterRepl`, `_warmModelCacheQuietly`, `_awaitHeadlessBackgroundJobs`, `_loadAgentContext`.
- `agent_cli_input.dart` (219) — the input dispatch pipeline: `_isPathLedChat`, `_replayRestoredSession`, `_handleLine`, `_routePendingInput`, `_dispatchInput`, `_sendUserMessage`, `_startRun`.
- `agent_cli_pickers.dart` (222) — slash-menu builder + TUI picker routing/openers: `_buildSlashMenu`, `_tuiPickerSelected`, wizard-picker completion, `_tuiPickSession/Provider/…`, `_openSessionsPicker`, `_sessionPickerRows`, `_openModePicker`, `_openApprovalPicker`. (`_tuiPickerHandlers` map + `_lastSessionRows`/`_sessionPickerFlat` fields stayed class members.)
- `agent_cli_run.dart` (261) — the run engine: `_keyStatusView`, `_abortRunOrCompaction`, `_redactUserText`, `_runPrompt`, `_beginUserPrompt`, `_settleAfterPrompt`, CodeMie re-auth, run-error handling, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, shell-job settle notices, `_afterRun`. (Per-run fields stayed in the class.)

**Extended existing parts** (both under 2000): `_onMcpChanged` → `agent_cli_tools.dart` (664); `_pluginConfig` → `agent_cli_ext.dart` (598).

**Slash-command table self-registration: nothing to do — already satisfied, so I changed nothing.** The primary file holds no command dispatch table: `_infoCommandHandlers` already lives in `agent_cli_commands.dart`, and each command family self-dispatches via its own extension in its own part (`_handleInfoCommand`/`_handleModelProviderCommand`/`_handleSessionSwitchCommand`/`_handleModeCommand`/`_handleUnknownCommand`). Splitting the info table into per-part merged maps was possible mechanically (map lookup has no ordering semantics), but it adds duplicate-key risk at merge time for zero churn-distribution gain since the table is already in a part — skipped per the ticket's low-risk-only guidance. Match ordering is untouched.

**Analyze:** `dart analyze lib/src/cli` — no errors/warnings; only pre-existing info-level lints in files I didn't touch (fa_tui, tui_*, provider_models, etc.). `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on all 7 touched files.

**Tests (test/cli):** `dart test test/cli` crashes with a native heap-corruption abort (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk detected`) — reproduced **identically on a pristine HEAD worktree** (same crash point, same message), so it is a pre-existing environment/FFI flake, not caused by this refactor. As an honest full signal, I ran all 209 `test/cli/*_test.dart` files individually: **209/209 pass** (including agent_cli_run/input-adjacent suites: busy gate, steering, compaction continuation, headless/HEP, sessions pickers, provider flows).
